rounds.clue: u tama kana u ṱoḓa tshithu
rounds.story: fun ndi mudzi wa u tama, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita funa.

rounds.clue: u sedza maipfi a bugu wa a pfesesa
rounds.story: vhal ndi mudzi wa u pfesesa maipfi, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita vhala.

rounds.clue: u wana nḓivho nga u funzwa
rounds.story: gud ndi mudzi wa u wana nḓivho, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita guda.
tamb ndi mudzi wa mutambo, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita tamba.

rounds.clue: u wana tshithu nga u badela tshelede
rounds.story: reng ndi mudzi wa u badela wa wana tshithu, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita renga.
lal ndi mudzi wa u awela, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita lala.

rounds.clue: u bvisa miṱodzi mbilu yo vhavhaho
rounds.story: lil ndi mudzi wa miṱodzi, a ndi mafele a ipfi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita lila.
mu ndi mathomo a dzina ḽa muthu muthihi, thu ndi mudzi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita muthu.

rounds.clue: vhanzhi vha no tshila sa riṋe
rounds.story: vha ndi mathomo a dzina ḽa vhanzhi, thu ndi mudzi. Zwoṱhe zwi ita vhathu.

rounds.clue: bindu ḽine muthu a ḽi ita nga maanda
rounds.story: mu ndi mathomo a dzina, shum ndi mudzi wa u shuma, o ndi mafele. Zwoṱhe zwi ita mushumo.
